narrative.headline: 2020 Jeep Wrangler: steering dominates the owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 586 complaints with NHTSA. Steering is by far the most reported area at 40%, followed by the electrical system at 28%. No deaths are reported. Most fires show up under the electrical system (6) and engine (5), so pay attention to those areas during a test drive and inspection.
